newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tofas to produce three Fiat models. [CORRECTED 13:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Turk Tofas to produce three Fiat models. [CORRECTED 13:25 GMT]

text.p: Leading Turkish car maker Tofas Turk Otomobil Fabrikasi said it signed a licence agreement with its foreign owner Fiat Auto SpA to undertake investments to begin producing Palio, Sienna and Palio weekend models in its Bursa plant in 1998.

The project is part of a newly signed agreement by partners Fiat and Turkish industrial conglomerate Koc Holding on investment, production, export and distribution activities of their joint-venture firms Tofas Turk and its distributor arm Tofas Oto Ticaret, Koc and Tofas said in separate statements.
They said 130,000 of Tofas Turk's 250,000-car annual output capacity would be allocated for the project to produce the three Fiat models.
Tofas Turk, in which Koc and Fiat each hold a 37.86 percent stake, had announced in April it would spend a total of $262 million on investments in the 1997-1999 period.
Fiat holds a 37.5 percent stake and Koc 28.45 percent in Tofas Oto.

"A joint management principle was accepted in the agreement signed on June 26 by Fiat Auto and Koc Holding on investment, production, export and distribution activities of Tofas Turk and Tofas Oto" the Koc statement said.
The sides also agreed to appoint a Turkish general manager to Tofas Turk and an Italian general manager to distributor Tofas Oto (corrects appointments).
Tofas produced 38,665 cars in the first five months of 1997, down from 49,722 in the same 1995 period.
